title: KCF Coverage-of-Coverage (Meta-Coverage) Report v1
description: Measures the coverage system itself: for every grammar construct family, whether the coverage model declares an obligation for it (with a registered evaluator and, ideally, fixtures). A construct family with no obligation is reported as 'coverage-policy-missing' so it is never silently treated as complete.

orphanObligations.description: Obligations whose dimension is not a known construct family (likely a typo/stale dimension).

regressionGated.description: At least one obligation in this family has a positive+negative fixture verified this run.

status.description: covered = has obligations; conditional/intentionally-none = an explicit familyPolicies decision (deliberate); coverage-policy-missing = no obligation AND no declared decision (unfinished).

policyReason.description: Reason from familyPolicies when status is conditional/intentionally-none.

fixtureGovernance.description: Coverage of the fixture layer: how many obligations declare positive/negative fixtures, and (when verified) how many actually fire correctly.
